Backtesting found no matching high-dimensional, T256, lr=.003 Adagrad depth pairs in history or lab. At lr=.0001, deeper extra-LN residual Adagrad models instead won 2/2 lab pairs; smooth Adagrad models won only 2/4 architecture-confounded comparisons overall. Thus neither shallow-depth nor smooth-activation preference supports a tested general correction.
